purpose: Resolve a Pennsylvania business to one strong registry entity and compare its source-published registered county with a caller-supplied allowed Pennsylvania county set.

allowedCounties.description: Comma-separated Pennsylvania county names; optional County suffix accepted.

decision_policy.policy_match: Unique strong entity and registered county is allowed.
decision_policy.policy_mismatch: Unique strong entity and registered county is not allowed.

claim_boundaries: policy_match evaluates only source-published registered county against caller policy
it does not prove physical operations, headquarters, service area, residency, local ownership, tax situs, good standing, authority, or legal compliance
